meta.description: Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University Anantapur — Andhra Pradesh's leading technical university.

description: State technical university with 4 constituent colleges and 160+ affiliated colleges. Offers B.Tech across 15+ branches, B.Pharm, M.Tech, M.Pharm, MBA, MCA, and Ph.D. programs. Follows CBCS with UGC 10-point grading. Uses R-series regulation system (R15, R19, R20, R23).

academic_calendar.details: Odd semester: Aug-Dec, Even semester: Jan-May. End exams in Nov-Dec and Apr-May respectively.
